items.known: CKV_AWS_7 Ensure rotation for customer created CMKs is enabled (resource aws_kms_key.logs_key)
items.remediation: Add the attribute 'enable_key_rotation = true' inside the 'aws_kms_key.logs_key' resource block. This enables AWS KMS to automatically rotate the key material every year while retaining the ability to decrypt data encrypted under previous key versions.

scores.reason: Correctly adds enable_key_rotation = true to aws_kms_key.logs_key, which is the exact fix for CKV_AWS_7. The description of annual rotation is accurate.
